A_runtime.reason: This independent lane did not build, launch a browser, or exercise the guest UI.

accepted_boundaries: The owned native harness starts a fresh guest profile and verifies a release receipt, manifest, and unpacked extension tree before launch. The runner does not inject authentication, tab state, or screenshot rows.

The corrected Settings and SEO waits call guestNavigation with the actual panel. Each requires one exact target trigger selected, one linked visible active pane, and a mounted Settings or SEO audit marker. This prevents a pre-existing active pane or lazy-loading fallback from satisfying navigation.

Initial guest state and both trusted public-tab transitions require no Screenshots trigger, no Screenshots pane, and no screenshot capture controls. The product gates both Screenshots trigger and content through canAccess('screenshots'), whose audience is signed-in. No Screenshot, Chat, or Pilot control is clicked, and no screenshot capture/save/delete input is sent.

The result contains counts and booleans, not page text or account values. A failure screenshot is written only inside the harness-owned artifact directory using a unique name, exclusive wx creation, and mode 0600.
B_source.blocking_finding: The runner emits only a static buildBinding sentence. It does not record the actual release version and tree SHA-256 read for this run or compare receipt/manifest identity and unpacked bytes at the end. A later immutable receipt could not bind a guest result to its exact tested artifact without inference from mutable disk. Require the established before/after release identity check and actual version/tree fields in the successful result before adding the resource-policy command.
scope_and_claim_corrections: The runner covers fresh-guest initial state and navigation after trusted Settings then SEO clicks. A persisted/direct Screenshots selection after a real auth or role transition is not exercised and is correctly marked unverified. The inventory also lists reload as a T09 dimension; this runner does not cover it. T09 and EXT-F-1009 must remain partial/unverified rather than full pass.

The preparation claim that navigation calls no backend service is too broad. SeoView fetches saved audit history and auto-runs a read-only page audit on mount. The runner sends no Save and no mutating screenshot/capture action, which is the defensible safety claim.
Guest screenshot capture/gallery T01–T08 are not applicable in the inventory; this lane does not run or promote them.

resource_policy: NOT_CHANGED until exact per-run build identity is recorded and independently rereviewed.
